proposals.problemSummary: Test failed due to state collision or data expiration (e.g. duplicate account email, expired session, or unseeded test entity).
proposals.recommendedAction: Ensure dynamic test data isolation using unique timestamped entities (e.g. generateUniqueUser) or configure automated pre-test database seeding and teardown fixtures.
proposals.rationale: Stateful data collisions must be mitigated through isolated dynamic test fixtures rather than static shared accounts to ensure test repeatability.
